verdict.rationale: Cloudflare markets Workers/AI agent support and hibernating WebSockets that charge only for compute (cloudflare-docs-2, cloudflare-docs-6), suggesting some agent-state persistence, but there is no evidence of an automatic 'checkpointing' mechanism, and hands-on community feedback explicitly states CPU time limits (30s free/15min paid) make Workers unsuitable for long-running agent tasks, pushing developers to self-host instead (cloudflare-comm-9).
